scanNote: Skanda oldingi o'quvchining qo'lyozma javoblari bor. 4-mashqda hammasi to'g'ri, lekin 5-mashqda artikl xatolari ('a astronaut', 'an taxi driver') va birlik/ko'plik xatosi ('He's an surgeons') bor; 6-mashqda esa jins xatosi (Sara — ayol, lekin 'his' deb yozgan). Bu xatolar 'Ko'p uchraydigan xato' bo'limida saqlangan.

exercises.explanationUz:
Yana to'rtta xarakter sifati.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  patient — sabrli
  lazy    — dangasa
  noisy   — shovqinli
  friendly — do'stona

DIQQAT — 'patient' ikki ma'noda:
  He is patient.   — U sabrli (SIFAT)
  He is a patient. — U bemor (OT)
Farqi artiklda: 'a' bo'lsa — ot.

items.textEn: 5  She doesn't get angry easily. She's ____ .
items.whyUz: Jahli chiqmaydigan odam — SABRLI (patient). 'beautiful' — ko'rinish sifati, mos emas.

items.textEn: 6  She doesn't like working. She is ____ .
items.whyUz: Ishlashni yoqtirmaydigan odam — dangasa (lazy). Aksi: hard-working (mehnatkash).

items.textEn: 7  The boy makes a lot of noise. He is ____ .
8  What's she like? She's kind and ____ .
items.whyUz: 'kind' (mehribon) ijobiy sifat — unga mos ijobiy sifat kerak. 'aggressive' va 'rude' salbiy.

exercises.instructionEn: Label the people with their jobs, then ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Odamlarni kasblari bilan belgilang, so'ng namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASBLAR RO'YXATI:
  surgeons    — jarrohlar (KO'PLIK!)
  actress     — aktrisa
  astronaut   — kosmonavt
  doctor      — shifokor
  taxi driver — taksi haydovchisi
  dentist     — tish shifokori

RASMLAR:
  1) stetoskopli ayol            → doctor (namuna)
  2) skafandrdagi odam           → astronaut
  3) tishni davolayotgan odam    → dentist
  4) operatsiya xonasidagi odamlar → surgeons
  5) taksi yonidagi erkak        → taxi driver
  6) sahnadagi ayol              → actress

UCHTA QOIDA:
  1) BIRLIKDA kasb oldida A yoki AN SHART
  2) A yoki AN — keyingi so'zning TOVUSHIGA qarab:
     a doctor, a dentist, a taxi driver  (undosh)
     an astronaut, an actress            (unli)
  3) KO'PLIKDA artikl QO'YILMAYDI va savol ham o'zgaradi:
     What are their jobs? — They're surgeons.

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 'He's A astronaut', 'He's AN taxi driver' va 'He's AN surgeonS' deb yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
UCH XATO:
1) 'astronaut' UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN astronaut ('a' EMAS).
2) 'taxi driver' UNDOSH tovush bilan boshlanadi → A taxi driver ('an' EMAS).
3) 'surgeons' KO'PLIK — artikl umuman qo'yilmaydi va savol 'What ARE THEIR JOBS?' bo'ladi, javob esa 'THEY'RE surgeons'.
A/AN tanlashda HARFGA emas, TOVUSHGA qarang.

items.question: What's her job?
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Ayol → her / She's. 'doctor' /d/ undosh → a.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz: 'astronaut' /æ/ UNLI tovush bilan boshlanadi → AN astronaut.

items.question: What are their jobs?
items.whyUz: KO'PLIK! Savol 'What ARE THEIR JOBS?', javob 'THEY'RE surgeons'. Artikl YO'Q.

items.question: What's his job?
items.whyUz: 'taxi' /t/ undosh → a. Qo'shma so'z: taxi + driver.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and fill in the possessive pronouns/adjectives or the people's names.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va egalik olmoshi/sifati yoki odamlarning ismini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi:

  Lucy          — pencils (qalamlar)
  Mark and John — CDs (disklar)
  Bill          — dog (it)
  Tom           — hat (shlyapa)
  Greg          — bicycle (velosiped)
  Joe           — boots (etiklar)
  Rob and Jane  — car (mashina)
  Tim           — basketball (basketbol to'pi)
  Carol         — books (kitoblar)
  Sarah         — cat (mushuk)

NAMUNA:
  A: Are these pencils Lucy's?
  B: Yes, they're HERS. They're HER pencils.

QOLIP:
  Birinchi bo'shliq — OT YO'Q  → egalik OLMOSHI
                                 (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
  Ikkinchi bo'shliq — OT BORmi?
                     bor  → egalik SIFATI (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's
                     yo'q → ism + 's

DIQQAT — JINSGA qarang:
  Lucy, Sarah, Carol, Jane — AYOL → hers / her
  Mark, John, Bill, Tom, Greg, Joe, Tim, Rob, Jeff — ERKAK → his
  ikki kishi — theirs / their

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 3-bandda 'Is that Sarah's cat?' savoliga 'Yes, it's HIS. It's HIS cat.' deb javob bergan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
XATO — Sarah AYOL ismi. Ayol uchun 'hers' (olmosh) va 'her' (sifat) ishlatiladi. To'g'ri javob: 'Yes, it's HERS. It's HER cat.'
Ingliz tilida egalik olmoshi EGASINING jinsiga qarab tanlanadi, narsaga emas — o'zbek tilida bunday farq yo'q, shuning uchun bu xato ko'p uchraydi.

lines.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Lyusi — ayol. Otsiz → hers, ot bilan → her.

lines.textEn: Are those CDs Rob and Jane's?

lines.hintUz: Rob va Jeyn — ikki kishi; rasmda disklar boshqa ikki kishiniki
lines.whyUz: Ularniki EMAS → 'theirs' (ikki kishi, otsiz). Rasmda disklar Mark va Jonniki → 's oxirgi ismga.

lines.hintUz: Sara — AYOL ismi. Birinchisi otsiz, ikkinchisi ot bilan
lines.whyUz: Sara — ayol → hers (olmosh) va her (sifat). 'his' XATO.

lines.hintUz: Jeff — erkak; rasmda it boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Jeffniki EMAS → 'his'. Rasmda it Billniki → Bill's.

lines.textEn: Is that Mark and John's bicycle?

lines.hintUz: Ikki kishi; rasmda velosiped boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Ularniki EMAS → 'theirs'. Rasmda velosiped Gregniki → Greg's.

lines.textEn: Is that Rob and Jane's car?

lines.hintUz: Ikki kishi. Birinchisi otsiz, ikkinchisi ot bilan
lines.whyUz: Rasmda mashina ularniki. Otsiz → theirs, ot bilan → their. Bu ikkisi FARQ qiladi!
Rasmda kitoblar Kerolniki. Ayol → hers / her.

lines.hintUz: Savolda 'my' — javobda 'sening'; rasmda etiklar boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Savolda 'my' → javobda 'yours'. Rasmda etiklar Jouniki → Joe's.

lines.hintUz: Savolda 'your' — javobda o'zi haqida; rasmda to'p boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Savolda 'your' → javobda 'mine'. Rasmda to'p Timniki → Tim's basketball.

lines.hintUz: Bill — erkak; rasmda shlyapa boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Billniki EMAS → 'his'. Rasmda shlyapa Tomniki → Tom's.

groups.explanationUz: Artikl keyingi so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarab tanlanadi, HARFIGA emas.
Otga -y qo'shilsa, 'shu xususiyatga ega' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi.

groups.ruleUz: Bir so'z — ikki ma'no (sifat va ot)

groups.explanationUz: Bu betdagi kasblar turli yo'llar bilan yasalgan.

patterns.formula: What's his/her job? — He's/She's + A/AN + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: What's her job? — She's a doctor. What's his job? — He's an astronaut.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning kasbi nima? — U shifokor. Uning kasbi nima? — U kosmonavt.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlikda artikl SHART. A yoki AN — tovushga qarab.

patterns.formula: What are their jobs? — They're + kasb (ko'plikda, artiklsiz).
patterns.exampleEn: What are their jobs? — They're surgeons.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'plikda artikl YO'Q. 'job' ham ko'plikda: jobS.

patterns.formula: Are these + ot + ISM's? — Yes, they're + EGALIK OLMOSHI. They're + EGALIK SIFATI + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: Are these pencils Lucy's? — Yes, they're hers. They're her pencils.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qalamlar Lyusinikimi? — Ha, uniki. Bular uning qalamlari.
patterns.explanationUz: Birinchi javob otsiz (olmosh), ikkinchisi ot bilan (sifat).

patterns.formula: No, it isn't + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + ISM's.
patterns.exampleEn: Is that Jeff's dog? — No, it isn't his. It's Bill's.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu Jeffning itimi? — Yo'q, uniki emas. Billniki.
patterns.explanationUz: Rad etish va haqiqiy egasini aytish. Ikkalasida ham ot takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: Are those my ...? — No, they're not yours. They're + ISM's.
patterns.exampleEn: Are those my boots? — No, they're not yours. They're Joe's.
patterns.exampleUz: Anavi etiklar meningmi? — Yo'q, seniki emas. Jounikilar.
patterns.explanationUz:
Savolda 'my' bo'lsa, javobda 'yours' bo'ladi —
chunki gapiruvchi almashadi.

patterns.exampleEn: She doesn't get angry easily. She's patient.
patterns.exampleUz: U tez jahli chiqmaydi. U sabrli.
patterns.explanationUz: Avval xulq inkor orqali tasvirlanadi, keyin sifat aytiladi.
